name: Pocket-ID
description: A simple OIDC provider that allows users to authenticate with their passkeys to your services.

variables.name: App URL
variables.description: The URL where you will access the app. Recommended to change from default.

variables.name: Behind Proxy
variables.description: Whether the app is behind a reverse proxy.

variables.name: Encryption Key
variables.description: A secure random key used for encrypting sensitive data. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`

variables.name: Maxmind License Key
variables.description: License Key for the GeoLite2 Database. If the key is not provided, IP locations will be marked as unknown in audit logs.

variables.name: Disable UI Configuration
variables.description: Disable the ability to configure the app via the UI. If enabled, you must set all required environment variables. See documentation: https://pocket-id.org/docs/configuration/environment-variables/#overriding-the-ui-configuration

variables.name: Database - Connection String
variables.description: The connection string for the database. If using SQLite, this should be left as is.

variables.name: Upload Path
variables.description: Path inside the container where uploaded files are stored

variables.name: Keys Path
variables.description: Path inside the container where keys are stored

variables.name: GeoLite2 Database Path
variables.description: Path to the GeoLite2 database file.

variables.name: GeoLite2 Download Link
variables.description: The URL to download the GeoLite2 database.

variables.name: Internal Port
variables.description: The port inside the container on which the server should listen. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Internal Host
variables.description: The host inside the container on which the server should listen. Not recommended to change.
